create.name: Laura Berman Fortgang
create.bio:
Laura Berman Fortgang is a life and career coach, author and interfaith minister who lives and works in Montclair, New Jersey. She came to coaching in its early days, after a first career as a performer, and was among the people who helped set up the International Coach Federation. Her company, InterCoach, has worked with private clients, corporations and public bodies for close to three decades, but the thread running through her work is a simple question many people meet in midlife: what am I meant to do next?

Her answer is a method she calls Now What?, which asks people to search inwards before they search job listings. Clients look back over their own history for clues, name what actually makes work satisfying for them, face their fears about money and learn to take their intuition seriously. She has set this out in several books, among them Take Yourself to the Top, The Prosperity Plan, The Little Book on Meaning and Now What?, her ninety-day guide to a change of direction. She teaches it through private coaching, talks and weekend programmes at Kripalu, and also trains other coaches. Her TEDx talk on finding your calling without starting from the résumé has passed two million views.

books.title: Now What? Revised Edition: 90 Days to a New Life Direction
books.author: Laura Berman Fortgang
books.description: Laura's best-known book sets out her ninety-day Now What? process for working out a new direction in work or life, step by step. The revised edition adds a further decade of client stories and updated exercises.

books.title: The Little Book on Meaning: Why We Crave It, How We Create It
books.author: Laura Berman Fortgang
books.description: A short, reflective book that grew out of a period when Laura's own work stopped feeling meaningful to her. It argues that meaning is usually built from small, everyday choices rather than grand changes.

books.title: The Prosperity Plan: Ten Steps to Beating the Odds and Creating Extraordinary Wealth (and Happiness)
books.author: Laura Berman Fortgang
books.description: Ten steps for building financial and emotional security in a changed economy. Laura's case is that a steady sense of your own worth and potential matters more than old habits of loyalty and fitting in.

books.title: Take Yourself to the Top: The Secrets of America's #1 Career Coach
books.author: Laura Berman Fortgang
books.description: Laura's first book, written in the early years of professional coaching. It walks readers through taking charge of their careers and the wider shape of their lives.

courses.title: Now What? Clarity for Your Career and Life
courses.description: A weekend programme at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, based on Laura's Now What? method, for anyone stuck on what to do next in work or life. Through practical exercises the group looks at limiting beliefs, money worries, clues from the past and intuition, and each person leaves with a plan.

courses.title: Coaching with Laura
courses.description: Private coaching for people facing a career or life change, or a stuck business. Laura works by asking questions rather than giving instructions, and new clients start with an intake form.

free_resources.title: Now What? Quiz
free_resources.description: The intake quiz from Laura's book Now What?, sent free by email after a short sign-up. It helps you see which areas of work and life most need attention before you plan a change.

free_resources.title: Three Clues to Clarity
free_resources.description: Free tip sheets for people who feel stuck about their career direction. They describe the three most common blocks to clarity and offer starting points for finding a way forward.

flags: Her site (laurabermanfortgang.com) returns 406 to plain curl, so I could not save it as HTML. I read it through WebFetch summaries, which give no verbatim text. The bio check therefore ran against the Kripalu pages and Amazon blurbs only. The bio was written from notes, but a human may want to spot-check it against her About page.
Her Now What? course site, nowwhatcoaching.com, looks hacked: its home page is full of casino spam links. It is not linked here, and she may want to be told.
She is mainly a career and life coach, with interfaith minister credentials. The spiritual side (meaning, purpose, intuition) is real but light; owner to confirm she fits.
Much of her YouTube channel is short business tips for coaches (Friday Focus); I picked only the purpose- and career-direction videos.
Her TEDx talk (2.16M views) is on the TEDx Talks channel, not hers.
The X/Twitter follower count was unreadable. Her readable total is far below the luminary line, so the tier is unlikely to change.
Name check: she is a different person from Dr. Laura Berman, the relationships author.
